aws.name: AWS
aws.pattern: Containers that scale to zero on AWS
aws.blurb: How each member of the cast is served by AWS: agents run as containers that exist only while they work, behind a load balancer, with state in object storage.
rows: Application Load Balancer in front of the container services for ingress and egress; VPC with security groups and private endpoints
Amazon ECS on Fargate, one task definition per agent, Amazon ECR for images, Amazon S3 bucket for agent memory, an IAM role per agent
Amazon S3 with Object Lock for sealed ledger checkpoints
AWS Cost Explorer and the ECS inventory, through a read-only IAM role
No provider service. Runs inside the control plane; identity comes from your OIDC provider
No provider service. A one-minute clock inside the control plane
AWS CodeBuild for agent builds and skill checks, Amazon ECR, a versioned S3 bucket for configuration
Amazon EventBridge for the event bus, OpenTelemetry for metrics and traces

gcp.name: GCP
gcp.pattern: Containers that scale to zero on Google Cloud
gcp.blurb: How each member of the cast is served by Google Cloud: agents run as jobs that exist only while they work, with state in object storage.
rows: Cloud Run services for ingress and egress; VPC with Cloud NAT
Cloud Run jobs, one per agent, Artifact Registry for images, Cloud Storage bucket for agent memory, a service account per agent
Cloud Storage with a retention policy for sealed ledger checkpoints
Cloud Billing export to BigQuery, and the Cloud Run inventory, through a read-only service account
No provider service. Runs inside the control plane; identity comes from your OIDC provider
No provider service. A one-minute clock inside the control plane
Cloud Build for agent builds and skill checks, Artifact Registry, a versioned Cloud Storage bucket for configuration
Pub/Sub and Cloud Audit Logs for the event bus, OpenTelemetry for metrics and traces
